account: Something more than an ordinary lighting inspection seems to be planned for eighteen hundred in the great hall. Builder specifically asked me to leave the hall closed until then, and mentioned a service acknowledgement. Neighbour says builder asked them to bring me along for that acknowledgement, but has left the details for the organisers to share. Neighbour has also been asking people for bread and grain donations for a community supper. Innkeeper was reported carrying a sack of bread to the town hall; baker and freight have been discussing the correct door. Builder, freight, innkeeper, neighbour and secretary are now gathered here ahead of the appointed time. Secretary has kept the inspection on my approved schedule and says they will accompany me; there is no new correspondence or council business awaiting me. I suspect the lighting inspection is also an occasion for a community supper and a deliberately undisclosed tribute or thank-you. The effort to bring me with an escort and keep the hall closed makes me wonder whether the acknowledgement is for me, perhaps a surprise, but nobody has actually told me whose service is being recognised. I should not treat that guess as established fact.
